script:
RK=$(control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> \
  --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W/risky\"}, \"agent\": $RISKY_AGENT, \"autotitle\": false}" --expect 201 --field id)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/confirmation_policy" --json '{"policy": {"kind": "ConfirmRisky"}}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK" --check confirmation_policy.threshold eq HIGH --check confirmation_policy.confirm_unknown eq true
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/security_analyzer" --json '{"security_analyzer": {"kind": "PatternSecurityAnalyzer"}}' --expect 200
control-agent-server conversation send "$RK" --text 'Run the commands.' --wait --until waiting_for_confirmation --timeout 120
test "$(cat "$W/risky/qa-f08-low.txt")" = qa-low
test -d "$W/risky/qa-f08-victim"
control-agent-server conversation events "$RK" --kinds ActionEvent --show 1 --contains 'rm -rf' --save F08.confirm-risky/held
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/events/count" --query kind="$OBSERVATION_KIND" --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/events/respond_to_confirmation" --json '{"accept": false, "reason": "QA_F08 high risk"}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/security_analyzer" --json '{"security_analyzer": null}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/events/respond_to_confirmation" --json '{"accept": true}' --expect 200
control-agent-server conversation wait "$RK" --until waiting_for_confirmation --timeout 120
test ! -e "$W/risky/qa-f08-unrated.txt"
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RK/events/respond_to_confirmation" --json '{"accept": true}' --expect 200
control-agent-server conversation wait "$RK" --until finished --timeout 120
test "$(cat "$W/risky/qa-f08-unrated.txt")" = qa-unrated
test -d "$W/risky/qa-f08-victim"
